title: Environments
summary: Your personal projects and each organization have separate environments, each with its own projects, chats, notes, usage and settings. Your profile, language, theme and plan are the same everywhere. An organization's policy applies only in its environment.
usage: If you belong to an organization, a selector under the logo lists Personal and your organizations; choosing one reloads the window with that environment. In an organization's environment, the side menu shows only that organization. A new environment starts with default settings and only the essential mods: install the agents you use from their pages on the site. Changes from other computers or the site show up after the next sync. You can also switch with Ctrl+K.
